name: Chapman University Summer Engineering Academy
org: Chapman University, Fowler School of Engineering
what_you_do: Take hands-on engineering workshops on campus. Topics include AI, game development, bioprinting, 3D printing and app design. You need no experience.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 8 to 12 for the 2026-27 school year. No prior experience is needed.
pay_detail: The cost is not stated on the program page.
duration: Workshops. The 2026 bioprinting workshop was one day.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are not posted. Join the interest list on the program page.
how_to_apply: Join the interest list for 2027 on the program page. Sign up for each workshop on the same page when it opens.
notes: Workshops are at the Keck Center for Science and Engineering, 450 N. Center St., Orange. Questions: engineering@chapman.edu or 714-516-5616.
